name: hackriff-ui
description: hackriff web UI (T-022a, T-044, T-051): WebGL2 waterfall over the stream bridge, SDR control panel, region-over-time history

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/audio-worklet.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/audio-worklet.js && cp src/index.html src/style.css dist/
scripts.test: esbuild test/axis.test.ts test/selections.test.ts test/inspect.test.ts test/listen.test.ts test/controls.test.ts test/outputs.test.ts test/inventory.test.ts test/frame-inspector.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/hk-ui-test --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/axis.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/selections.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/inspect.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/listen.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/controls.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/outputs.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/inventory.test.mjs && node node_modules/hk-ui-test/frame-inspector.test.mjs
